blocks.x: Now you're playing on the river oat in St. Louis--that's the summer of '27; right?
Wait now, I think that was '28.
Because there was something about Red Allen sitting in--Red Allen was working around there at that time.
No; I've got that written down. We were on the steamer, St. Paul, in '28.
The St. Paul or the J.S.?
No, we were on the St. Paul.
Now, is this where Charles Pillars joined the band or is he in the band already?
